name: Rack-95
author: Stephane Schmitz
summary: A 1990s-style rack multi-effects unit: 33 single, series, parallel and dual configurations of reverb (hall, room, plate, reverse), delay (stereo, ping-pong, multi-tap), chorus, flanger, pitch shifter, rotary speaker and auto pan; 128 programs; a front panel with a backlit LCD. Akai MPC Plugin SDK; Gen1 and Gen2.
